title: Gatekeeping + Compatibility Matrix for Private/VPC/On-prem Request Intake
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: Create a practical gatekeeping and risk-scoring playbook plus a compatibility matrix to triage Private/VPC/on-prem requests. Focus areas: networking constraints (firewalls, egress rules, DNS), upgrade paths and version skew tolerances, and air-gapped packaging requirements. Goal: reduce decision turnaround for enterprise intake from weeks to <72 hours and make routing decisions repeatable (self-serve vs sales-assisted vs engineering-led).

Scope:
- In-scope: request intake rubric, scoring thresholds, standard ask templates, compatibility matrix (OS, K8s versions, container runtimes, CNI), networking topology templates, upgrade-onboarding playbook, air-gapped packaging checklist, required artifacts for security review.
- Out-of-scope: full automation of installer; deep vendor-specific image builds (handled by ENG as separate epics).

Why now: increasing volume of private deploy requests from regulated customers; inconsistent triage causes long leads and missed SLAs for Dedicated conversion. A lightweight but authoritative gate reduces churn and surfaces true product gaps (e.g., missing supported K8s versions, network dependencies).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Define a 10-point risk rubric with weighted categories (networking, upgrades, air-gap, auth/KMS, observability). 2) Publish a compatibility matrix spreadsheet linking supported OS/K8s/container/runtime and the minimally supported runtime/release. 3) Provide 3 templated intake forms (self-serve, sales-assisted, engineering-led) and decision flow. 4) Document an upgrade compatibility policy and a deprecation window. 5) Build a short triage runbook (steps + owner roles) and add to Confluence. 6) Pilot with two active enterprise requests and measure time-to-triage reduction.
deliverables: - Risk-scoring rubric (CSV). - Compatibility matrix (drive sheet link). - Intake form templates (Confluence + Support ticket). - Networking topology examples (VPN, PrivateLink, VPC peering). - Air-gapped packaging checklist and signing process. - Triage runbook and SLOs for response times.
decision_log:
2026-03-06: Agreed with Eng that we will support K8s 1.26+ for initial rollout; exceptions allowed with engineering signoff.
2026-03-09: Security requested that KMS/HSM integration be mandatory for any >P1 customer; added to rubric weight.
2026-03-12: Product and Sales agreed to a two-track intake: 'standard' (self-serve) and 'enterprise' (sales-assisted with engineering gate).
tradeoffs:
- Strict gating speeds triage but may increase friction for mid-market growth accounts.
- Broad K8s support increases maintenance burden for ENG but reduces lost opportunities.
- Air-gapped installers require build/time investment; initial approach: provide certified base images + documented steps, defer full image-build service to Dedicated contract add-on.
notes: Operability considerations: include explicit logs and tracer capture instructions so customers can provide minimal repros for failure. Recommend a 'minimum observability bundle' requirement for private deployments to meet our support SLAs.
